text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With a Junior Year of steady growth 
drawing to a close, it was time to decide 
on goals for the Classic Year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Cheval Grand isn't very good at 
speaking her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to get her to talk in a relaxed 
mood, I first took her outside, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um... I... haven't really been to 
places like this m-much before...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh-What should I do—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Th-There's so many people...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Boom!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
They left... Ugh... It's because I was 
spacing out...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, no, wait! You mean the place *I* want 
to go to, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm sorry. They all look the same to 
me... Vivlos—my little sister—would know, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Failed here too. Lively places don't seem 
very calming. In the end—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――……*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...T-The sea... is so calming, isn't 
it...? It's quiet... and there aren't many 
people around...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I often come here when I need to think... 
Or when I want to be alone.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... what's the matter today? You said 
you had something to talk about, right?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking we should decide on our 
goals for the Classic year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I left her completely flabbergasted. Maybe 
I should have just talked to her in the 
Trainer's Room without overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, when I previously asked Cheval 
Grand which races she wanted to enter—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I just don't really know how 
to choose that kind of thing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know I have to answer more clearly and 
crisply, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because she still lacked 
self-confidence, she ended up unable to 
find a goal."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, now that she's grown during the 
Junior Class, she might have developed 
some new requests.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought that maybe if she spoke in a 
relaxed state of mind... but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"My goals for the Classics... I'm sorry, I 
really don't have anything in 
particular..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the situation hasn't changed 
after all.
choice_data_list:
Aiming for the Classic Triple Crown, for 
example...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is an honorable 
title bestowed upon those who conquer the 
Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A supreme race where only the chosen 
Umamusume representing their generation 
are permitted to run. However—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? ...N-No way!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because... the Triple Crown is something 
only more talented Umamusume aim for... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true, even I yearn for it... It's a 
race that a "great Umamusume"... that 
person ran in, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, someone like me would just be 
presumptuous. It should be a much more 
amazing Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her Junior Class record and 
natural talent, taking on the Classic 
Triple Crown route is by no means an 
unusual choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it seemed she was still unable to 
view her own abilities objectively.
choice_data_list: (Maybe she just needs a little push…?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. As we were discussing our 
Classic Year goals once more, it suddenly 
got noisy outside.

text_block_list.name: Voice in the Hallway
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently the lineup is incredible!" 
"Whoaaa, then we absolutely HAVE to 
watch!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...What could it be? An event, perhaps...?
choice_data_list: Shall we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracing the source of the commotion, they 
found the stands bustling with a massive 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems a mock race is about to take 
place, with around ten Umamusume already 
gathered on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the one drawing the most attention 
among them is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family, known for their long 
years of contribution to the racing world. 
Among them, Satono Crown, renowned for her 
intellect, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not only her mother, but also her father 
and grandfather have had overwhelming 
records in the decathlon, making them a 
renowned athletic family in the sports 
world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Born from that supreme bloodline, a horse 
girl striving to be the 
"strongest"—Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those two are truly hailed as the elite 
among elites. As we move forward into the 
Classic period, they are contenders who 
cannot be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Crown-san really is so composed~! She's 
always so cool-headed and amazing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I came to watch Duramente-senpai. 
After all, racing demands a certain degree 
of roughness and fighting spirit."

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but this race has girls who'll be in 
the Senior class next year too, right?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No matter how talented those two are, 
isn't that a bit tough for them while 
they're still in the Junior Class?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even so, those two can put up a real 
fight. After all, Satono Crown has already 
won two races since her debut—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente may have dropped her debut race, 
but her maiden race was an overwhelming 
victory by six lengths.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's probably planning to run against 
higher-tier opponents now with an eye on 
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown... Miss Duramente...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to today's 
race. "Know your enemy and know yourself, 
and you will never be defeated"— I look 
forward to learning from you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Do as you please. ...I am only running 
because it serves my interests as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just a mock race, I have no 
intention of losing. I'll be giving it... 
my absolute all as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, the mock race began—

text_block_list.name: Crown & Dura
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!!! Ooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!! As expected of Crown-san! Precise 
course-taking and explosive acceleration. 
With this—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...No, not yet. Duramente-senpai's true 
strength is on the final straight—

text_block_list.name: Crown & Dura
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaaaaaaagh!!!! —Graaaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... amazing...! No wonder they say 
she's aiming for the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The older generation is being totally 
overwhelmed...! Man, next year's Classics 
are gonna be something to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What fierce spirit... Neither of them is 
backing down against superior 
opponents...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... Triple Crown horses really 
are something else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to catch what Cheval Grand was 
saying, but her mutterings were drowned 
out by the roar of the crowd. Just then—

Whoa, as expected of Kura-chan and 
Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't just be daydreaming either. If I'm 
aiming for the Satsuki Sho, I gotta train 
like whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A terribly cheerful voice rang out nearby. 
It was Cheval Grand's classmate, the 
festival girl Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Beside her is Satono Diamond, hailed as 
the treasure of the prestigious Satono 
family, just like Satono Crown who is 
competing in the race."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You haven't changed one bit, Kita-chan. 
The Classic Triple Crown has been your 
dream ever since you were little, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because that's the dream Teio-san 
was aiming for too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Both the Satsuki Sho and the Japan Derby 
were amazing! You had everyone in the 
audience completely captivated... That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for the Classic Triple Crown 
too! I'll win, and just like my idol 
Teio-san, point straight up at the sky 
with style!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......I see. Kita-san doesn't flinch... 
Not even against those two...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......You're all so radiant... everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Satono Crown and the others in 
their mock race made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If Cheval Grand continues to run in 
middle and long-distance races, they will 
surely stand before her as rivals. And――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If Cheval Grand cannot find confidence 
in herself, it will be difficult for her 
to challenge them.
choice_data_list: (She has plenty of talent, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to push her too hard. If she 
goes into the race intimidated and can't 
perform at her best, there's no point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the Classic Triple Crown is a 
once-in-a-lifetime stage for middle- and 
long-distance runners. A part of me really 
wanted to let her take on that challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even without taking the Triple Crown 
route, the day will come when I face those 
formidable foes. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san? Is something... the 
matter...?
choice_data_list: No, it's about your Classic goal, but...
No, it's about the Classic goals, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... y-yes...
choice_data_list:
How about taking on a graded race and 
aiming for top 3?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, considering her abilities, 
it's hardly a hurdle high enough to be 
strictly necessary."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, by steadily achieving her goals, 
we should be able to build up her 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... A graded race...?
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I know you can do it!
It's okay, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Y-Yes. I-I'll d-d-do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, our goal for the Classic class 
is set. We'll aim for a top-3 finish in at 
least three GIII or higher races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether we aim for that in the Triple 
Crown races can be decided each time by 
seeing how Cheval Grand is doing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You're allowed to aim even higher." For 
now, those words were kept tucked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You can aim even higher. I kept those 
words tucked away inside for now.
